name: Lano
summary: Lano lets you employ people in 170+ countries without local entities, with country-specific contracts and benefits. It lists its price in euros only, from 499 euros per employee per month, so US buyers should expect currency conversion on top.

evidence.capability: employment in countries without an entity

facts.text: Lano states it is SOC 2 Type II certified, in a post dated May 10, 2024.
Lano's pricing is set by proposal based on team size, number of countries and services, and volume discounts exist without published amounts.
Payments over SWIFT cost 25 euros per transaction, and local-network payments are free where available as part of an optional Integrated Payments add-on.

plans.name: Employer of Record
plans.notes: Listed as 'From 499 euros'. No USD price is published, so the figure is shown as listed

hiddenCosts: The price is in euros, so USD buyers face exchange rates.
SWIFT payments carry a 25 euro fee per transaction.
Immigration support and local compliance add-ons are priced during scoping.
